ValidationRule.description: Diplomatic and Official booklets are only issued against a stated clearance level. Enforced at the API level because record-type picklist subsetting does not bind integrations. Draft records remain freely saveable.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Draft")), OR( ISPICKVAL(Passport_Category__c, "Diplomatic"), ISPICKVAL(Passport_Category__c, "Official") ), ISBLANK(TEXT(Clearance_Level__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Select a Clearance Level before submitting a Diplomatic or Official passport application.
